text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition alone proves nothing. Women are well represented in planning, and panels often include HR and elected officials, so an all-women panel of four is unremarkable and would occur frequently by chance. It isn't evidence, and raising it would read as a grievance about the panel's identity rather than the process — which damages your credibility and any later complaint.

Also note director roles often weight political judgement, stakeholder handling and consultation over technical credentials. A geography bachelor's with strong consultation experience can legitimately outrank a licensed planner for that job.

Do pursue the feedback: send a polite written follow-up citing your original request and any applicable records or recruitment policy. Unexplained silence is the actual problem worth pressing.
